source.title: [re:DEFINICIJA] p. Božidar Nagy, SJ: Zašto je Crkvi potreban primjer bl. Ivana Merza? (ep. 10)

summary.title_hr: [re:DEFINICIJA] p. Božidar Nagy, SJ: Zašto je Crkvi potreban primjer bl. Ivana Merza? (ep. 10)
summary.abstract_hr: U 10. epizodi podcasta [re:DEFINICIJA] gost je p. Božidar Nagy, isusovac i donedavni postulator kauze bl. Ivana Merza. Govori o Merzovu životu: od rođenja u Banjoj Luci 1896. i školovanja preko studija u Beču i Parizu do vojne službe na talijanskom bojištu, koja ga je duhovno preobrazila, te rada profesora u Zagrebu. Ističe da je Merz prvi vjernik laik u Crkvi u Hrvata uzdignut na oltar i da je povezivao vjeru, znanost i kulturu. Prepričava osobne doživljaje iz rada na kauzi, nagli porast štovanja na Filipinima te Merzov poziv na javno svjedočenje vjere. Govori i o čudu iz 2018. koje čeka obradu u Dikasteriju za kauze svetaca radi kanonizacije.
key_topics: vjernik laik i svetost u svjetovnom zanimanju
štovanje bl. ivana merza na filipinima
javno svjedočenje vjere i molitva krunice
uslišanja po zagovoru bl. ivana merza
key_points: Bl. Ivan Merz prvi je vjernik laik u povijesti Crkve u Hrvata proglašen blaženim. Pokazao je da se svetost može postići u svijetu i u svjetovnom zanimanju, kao profesor francuskog i njemačkog jezika na Nadbiskupskoj gimnaziji.

Ratno razdoblje na talijanskom bojištu najviše je oblikovalo Merza. Sam je zapisao da je do rata njegov katolicizam bio 'estetski', a 5. veljače 1918. u dnevniku je zapisao prve životne odluke koje počinju riječima 'Boga nikad ne zaboraviti'.
Gost iz slike Ante Mamuše iščitava pet poruka Merzova lika: život laika u svijetu, povezanost vjere, znanosti i kulture, crkvenost, djelovanje Duha Svetoga te euharistiju kao srž njegove duhovnosti.

Štovanje bl. Ivana Merza najprije se proširilo na Filipinima, gdje je Dave de la Cruz osnovao udrugu s oko 200 članova i postao vicepostulator. Filipinska mladež prikupila je 7000 potpisa za molbu papi da Merza proglasi svetim.

Gost prepričava dirljiv susret 1979. s benediktinkom Marie-Denise Chaville, čije je oblačenje Merz 1921. opisao u dnevniku. Spominje i dva neočekivana pokrića troškova groba: lutrijsku srećku iz 1928. i dar nepoznatog darovatelja 1977.
Merz je zagovarao javno svjedočenje vjere. U pismu Marakoviću zamjera katolicima što se skrivaju dok mole, a u Zagrebu je svakodnevno molio krunicu prelazeći Trg bana Jelačića.

Dokumentacija o čudu koje se dogodilo na Merzovu grobu 2018. predana je Dikasteriju za kauze svetaca. Čudo još mora proći liječničku, teološku i kardinalsko-biskupsku komisiju prije dekreta o kanonizaciji.
key_topics_en: lay faithful and holiness in a secular profession
connection between faith, science, and culture
veneration of bl. ivan merz in the philippines
public witnessing of faith and praying the rosary
favors granted through the intercession of bl. ivan merz
key_points_en: Bl. Ivan Merz is the first lay faithful in the history of the Church among the Croats to be beatified. He showed that holiness can be attained in the world and in a secular profession, as a professor of French and German at the Nadbiskupska gimnazija.

The wartime period on the Italian front shaped Merz the most. He himself wrote that until the war his Catholicism had been 'aesthetic', and on February 5, 1918, he recorded in his diary his first life decisions that begin with the words 'never forget God'.

From Anto Mamuša's painting, the guest reads five messages of Merz's figure: the life of a lay person in the world, the connection of faith, science, and culture, ecclesiality, the action of the Holy Spirit, and the Eucharist as the core of his spirituality.

Veneration of Bl. Ivan Merz first spread in the Philippines, where Dave de la Cruz founded an association with about 200 members and became vice-postulator. The Philippine youth collected 7,000 signatures for a petition to the Pope to declare Merz a saint.

The guest recounts a touching meeting in 1979 with the Benedictine sister Marie-Denise Chaville, whose clothing ceremony Merz described in his diary in 1921. He also mentions two unexpected coverings of the grave expenses: a lottery ticket from 1928 and a gift from an unknown donor in 1977.

Merz advocated for the public witnessing of faith. In a letter to Maraković, he reproaches Catholics for hiding while praying, and in Zagreb he prayed the Rosary daily while crossing Trg bana Jelačića.

Documentation on the miracle that occurred at Merz's grave in 2018 was submitted to the Dicastery for the Causes of Saints. The miracle must still pass the medical, theological, and cardinal-bishop commission before a decree on canonization.
mentioned_organizations_en: Dicastery for the Causes of Saints
summary.title_en: [re:DEFINICIJA] Fr. Božidar Nagy, SJ: Why Does the Church Need the Example of Bl. Ivan Merz? (ep. 10)
summary.abstract_en: In the 10th episode of the [re:DEFINICIJA] podcast, the guest is Fr. Božidar Nagy, a Jesuit and until recently the postulator of the cause of Bl. Ivan Merz. He speaks about Merz's life: from his birth in Banja Luka in 1896 and his schooling through studies in Vienna and Paris to military service on the Italian front, which spiritually transformed him, and his work as a professor in Zagreb. He emphasizes that Merz is the first lay faithful in the Church among the Croats raised to the altar and that he connected faith, science, and culture. He recounts personal experiences from working on the cause, the sudden increase in veneration in the Philippines, and Merz's call to public witnessing of the faith. He also speaks about the miracle from 2018 awaiting processing at the Dicastery for the Causes of Saints for canonization.
